repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-device
repository.purpose: Device registration for the Webex JS SDK: registers, refreshes, and unregisters this client's device with the WDM service and exposes the device-derived state (URLs, feature toggles, organization policy) as the webex.internal.device plugin.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Changing registration, refresh, unregister, cleanup, feature handling, inactivity logout, the device-url interceptor, or IP network detection.
task_playbooks.fallback: If a requirement or invariant in the module spec conflicts with the code, stop and report the conflict instead of changing either silently.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Code changes alter a requirement, invariant, public surface, dependency, or failure mode documented in the module spec.
validate_with: Run the Repo Annotation spec-index and manifest checkers through the active installation
task_playbooks.fallback: Leave generated metadata and validation status untouched; validation is run by an independent runtime.

glossary.definition: Web device manager: the Webex service that stores device registrations.
glossary.notes: Reached through the wdm entry of the service catalog.

glossary.definition: This client's registration at WDM plus its local state, exposed as webex.internal.device.
A registration created with a TTL and refreshed on a timer instead of being persisted.
A named value from WDM in the developer, entitlement, or user collection, typed on parse.

evidence_rules.requirement: Cite only a script defined in package.json; the test script references test:integration, which package.json does not define.
State a behavior only when the source implements it; call it tested only when a test invokes it.
Document an export only if src/index.js exports it.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not use commit or pull-request history as evidence for why behavior exists.
negative_guidance.why: The package owner declared history is not trusted rationale evidence.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not describe the WDM service contract beyond what the code sends and reads.
negative_guidance.why: No machine-readable WDM contract is committed in this repository.

high.expectation: Source and a behavioral test both confirm the claim.

medium.expectation: Only source confirms the claim; state the missing test as a gap.

low.expectation: Neither source nor test confirms it; report the gap instead of documenting it.

main_entrypoints.name: plugin registration
main_entrypoints.purpose: Registers the device plugin, interceptor, and logout hook and defines the export surface.

workspace_packages.name: @webex/internal-plugin-device
workspace_packages.notes: Single package; its dependencies are other packages of the surrounding Yarn workspace.

rules: Orient first: state what the folder owns before listing files.
folder_readme_contract.example_policy: Examples are allowed only when taken from source or tests in this package.
folder_readme_contract.fallback: Omit a folder README when the module spec already covers the folder.

surface_owners.edit_boundary: Source and tests; keep the module spec in step with behavior changes.
Generated by Repo Annotation; edit through spec-reconcile and review.

fallback_rules: If a command is not defined in package.json, report it as missing instead of inventing one.
If code and a spec disagree, surface the conflict and do not edit the spec to match unverified behavior.

regression_feedback_rules.trigger: A change to device.js behavior ships without a matching requirement, invariant, or test update
required_followups: Update the affected requirement or invariant in src/docs/README.md
Add a unit test in test/unit/spec/device.js for the new behavior
regression_feedback_rules.notes: Requirements without test evidence are listed as gaps in the module spec Verification section.
